nodes.text:
The Indian Council of Medical Research @ICMRDELHI has detected 2 cases of Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV) in #Karnataka through surveillance. Both infants, aged 3 & 8 months, were treated for bronchopneumonia in Bengaluru & are now recovering, confirms @MoHFW_INDIA
